advisory.finding: test_deriving_advisory_health_writes_no_ticket_events is vacuous: derive_plan_material_pin_health (via pin_health.derive_health) never calls rebar._commands._seam.append_event on any path (warnings route through logger.warning), and with the fingerprint patched to 'x'*16 the pin resolves to 'stale-pin-drift' so even _warn_unreadable is not reached — the assertion `writes == []` passes trivially and cannot catch a regression that introduces a ticket-event write.
merged_from: test_deriving_advisory_health_writes_no_ticket_events asserts writes==[] against a monkeypatched rebar._commands._seam.append_event, but derive_plan_material_pin_health / pin_health.derive_health never reference append_event on any path (append_event exists only in sidecar.py), and the chosen drift fingerprint ('x'*16 != pinned) never reaches the sole ticket-reading branch (_warn_unreadable, which fires only on stale-pin-missing). The assertion is vacuously true and cannot detect a regression in the 'writes no ticket events' contract it claims to prove.
scenarios: A future change adds an append_event/ticket-write side effect inside derive_health or _warn_unreadable — this test would still pass, giving false assurance.
